While it does not appear naturally in [[PVP]], it can be sent there by a player for {{Money|4,000}} in the Molten Arena. The '''Molten Titan''' has fairly high health, higher than most enemies that appear before it, while also moving quite fast and having a decently high defense. Additionally, it always spawns with the [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] attribute, meaning it will turn into a [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] on death. ==Appearance== The '''Molten Titan''' has a neon orange body, covered with black molten rock, with only a few cracks revealing its body. It wears multiple pieces of armor constructed out of metal, including pants, a glove on its left arm, an arm-band with a blade attached to it, multiple pieces of metal around its left shoulder and a helmet with two black horns with thorns coming out of them. Its right arm is replaced with a mechanical arm, which has a large pauldron and its hand is connected to it with two rods. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers such as [[Minigunner]]s, [[Crook Boss]]es, [[Turret]]s and [[Ranger]]s can kill the '''Molten Titan''' easily. **The [[Commander]] can also assist these towers in defeating the '''Molten Titan''' by boosting their firerate. *You can use towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Warden]] to slow this down, as it is quite fast. **Do note that freezing towers, knockback towers and the [[Warden]] will slow down the '''Molten Titan''' for a shorter amount of time because of its large size. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MoltenTitan.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMoltenTitan.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} MoltenModeUpdateThumbnail.png|'''Molten Titan''' on a game thumbnail.
